name: Tola
bio: Tola was the grandson of Dodo and son of Puah, of the tribe of Issachar. After Abimelech's death, Tola arose to save Israel, living in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim, and judged Israel for twenty-three years before dying and being buried there (Judges 10:1-2). Though his record is brief, it makes clear that after the chaos of Abimelech's self-destructive seizure of power, Tola brought Israel twenty-three years of stable rule.
